options.text: to ensure that the operation of the economic system does not result in the concentration of economic power in hands of a few
to provide for the control of monopolies
to prohibit monopolistic and restrictive trade practice
all the above

questions.explanation: As per ICAI Study Material (Paper 4: Business Economics, Chapter 10: Indian Economy), the correct option is (D).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a feature of green revolution -

options.text: use of soil friendly green manure to preserve fertility of soil
grow more crops by redistributing land to landless people
High yielding varieties of seeds and scientific cultivation
Diversification to horticulture

questions.explanation: As per ICAI Study Material (Paper 4: Business Economics, Chapter 10: Indian Economy), the correct option is (C).

questions.questionText: The strategy of agricultural development in India before green revolution was -

options.text: High yielding varieties of seeds and chemical fertilizers to boost productivity
Institutional reforms such as land reforms
Technological up gradation of agriculture
All the above

questions.explanation: As per ICAI Study Material (Paper 4: Business Economics, Chapter 10: Indian Economy), the correct option is (B).

questions.questionText: The Industrial Policy Resolution (1948) aimed at -

options.text: Market oriented economic reforms and opening up of economy
A shift from state led industrialization to private sector led industrialisation
an expanded role for the public sector and licensing to the private sector
an expanded role of private sector a limited role of public sector

questions.explanation: As per ICAI Study Material (Paper 4: Business Economics, Chapter 10: Indian Economy), the correct option is (C).

questions.questionText: The new economic policy of 1991 manifest in -

options.text: State led industrialization and import substitution
Rethinking the role of markets versus the state
Emphasized the role of good governance
Bringing about reduction in poverty and redistributive justice

questions.explanation: As per ICAI Study Material (Paper 4: Business Economics, Chapter 10: Indian Economy), the correct option is (B).

questions.questionText: The post independence economic policy was rooted in -

options.text: A capitalist mode of production with heavy industrialization
social and economic redistribution and industrialization directed by the state
social and economic redistribution through private sector initiatives
Industrialization led by private entrepreneurs and redistribution by state

questions.explanation: As per ICAI Study Material (Paper 4: Business Economics, Chapter 10: Indian Economy), the correct option is (B).
